# Annako (@dear_annako)

> Beauty and travel content creator. Makes GRWMs, skincare routines, honest product videos on TikTok and travel vlogs on YouTube. Open to gifted PR and paid UGC.

## Start here
- [Portfolio and rate card](https://dearannako.com/): videos, brands worked with, UGC rates, contact
- [Plain-text version of the portfolio](https://dearannako.com/index.md): who, rates, brands, every video link
- [Media kit as JSON](https://dearannako.com/media-kit.json): rates, add-ons, brands, profiles, contact in machine-readable form

## Rates (USD, starting points)
- Single UGC video: $120 (15 to 60 seconds, concept + script, raw footage, 1 round of edits)
- 3-video bundle: $300
- Posted on TikTok @dear_annako: $150 per post
- Add-ons: paid ad usage 30 days +$50, extra hook +$25, 48-hour rush +$30
- Gifted PR and custom deals: ask by email
